## 更新内容

- 命令行环境：由 FlowEncode 自动安装的 Python、编码器、FFmpeg 和 Av1an 可在新打开的 cmd 与 PowerShell 中直接调用；切换工作目录后相关路径会同步更新
- Python 环境：设置引导会从 Python 3.12 至 3.14 的官方 Windows x64 稳定版中选择受支持版本，并完善 pip、vspipe 与 vsrepo 命令行的可用性检查
- 下载与安装：提升编码器、FFmpeg、Av1an 和 VapourSynth 插件自动安装与更新的可靠性，安装失败时保留原有可用版本
- 设置引导：卸载操作仅针对由 FlowEncode 自动安装的依赖，用户自行安装或手动导入的组件不会被移除
- 音频处理：修复中文 Windows 上调用用户自行提供的 deew / DEE 进行 DDP 转换时，deew 标志输出可能导致任务失败的问题

## Update Notes

- CLI environment: Python, encoders, FFmpeg, and Av1an installed through FlowEncode can be invoked directly from newly opened cmd and PowerShell sessions; related paths are synchronized after switching workspaces
- Python environment: the setup guide selects a supported official Windows x64 stable release from Python 3.12 through 3.14 and improves availability checks for the pip, vspipe, and vsrepo command-line tools
- Downloads and setup: improve the reliability of automatic installs and updates for encoders, FFmpeg, Av1an, and VapourSynth plugins while preserving the existing working version if installation fails
- Setup guide: uninstall actions only remove dependencies installed automatically through FlowEncode; user-installed or manually imported components are left unchanged
- Audio processing: fix DDP jobs failing on Chinese Windows when user-supplied deew / DEE is invoked and deew prints its logo
